source: Curated cross-species comparative neuroscience; NOT extracted from MaleCNS v1.0 (see per-unit provenance.extracted_from_malecns).
caveat: A functional unit is a curated sub-circuit pattern, not a measured cell assembly. Members name neuron populations from synthetic_bio_topology.MODULE_PROFILES; ratios are composition weights, not measured cell counts. Treat as a compositional scaffold with literature provenance, not as ground truth.

port_types.*: Wildcard: any port type (used by generic forms).
port_types.sensory.skylight_compass: Polarised-light / sun-compass heading cue (insect central complex).
port_types.sensory.electric.ampullary: Low-frequency passive electric-field signal (prey bioelectric field).
port_types.sensory.electric.tuberous: High-frequency active-electrolocation signal (own EOD amplitude + phase).
port_types.sensory.lateral_line: Water-flow / pressure-wave signal from the lateral line.
port_types.sensory.auditory.startle: Abrupt acoustic transient able to trigger a startle response.
port_types.olfactory.sparse_code: Sparse high-dimensional odour code (mushroom-body Kenyon-cell output).
port_types.olfactory.learned_valence: Learned appetitive/aversive value attached to an odour.
port_types.navigation.heading: Angular head-direction (bearing) estimate.
port_types.navigation.steering: Turn command that reduces the heading-to-goal error.
port_types.motor.song: Vocal-motor command (syllable timing and syringeal drive).
port_types.motor.arm: Arm motion command issued from the arm nerve cord.
port_types.efference.copy: Efference copy / corollary discharge of a self-generated motor command.

how_to_compose: 2. join an out-port to an in-port whose `type` matches (or via a connection type whose from_port/to_port constraints admit both);
3. validate with compose_from_units(); it checks port type compatibility, required-port satisfaction and acyclicity policy.

units.name: retinal_phototransduction_unit
units.description: 锥体/杆体双极细胞把光强转为分级电位，经水平细胞做增益控制后由 midget 节细胞输出高分辨率空间信号。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: retinal_direction_selective_unit
units.description: 星爆无长突细胞的延迟抑制与双极细胞兴奋相遇，只对特定运动方向放电。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: retinal_motion_onset_unit
units.description: ACL2 胆碱能无长突细胞在运动起始瞬间发放，给下游一个『有新事件』的突兀信号。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: retinal_irradiance_unit
units.description: 内在光敏节细胞直接被光驱动并缓慢持续放电，把环境亮度传给昼夜节律系统，不经图像通道。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: olfactory_transduction_unit
units.description: 嗅感觉神经元表达单一受体，经局部抑制性中间神经元做增益归一化后输出气味身份信号。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cochlear_amplification_unit
units.description: 外毛细胞的电致运动放大基底膜的微弱振动，是一段主动的机械增益级而非被动换能。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: vestibular_transduction_unit
units.description: 毛细胞把头部加速度转为放电，经前庭小脑叶做重力参考后再送往运动系统。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: somatosensory_dorsalhorn_unit
units.description: 痛觉与触觉传入在背角被甘氨酸能/回返性中间神经元预筛，形成门控式上行信号。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: thalamocortical_relay_unit
units.description: 中继细胞把上行信号送皮层，网状核形成局部抑制回路控制『门开多大』，是皮层的准入关口。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: visual_thalamic_relay_unit
units.description: 外膝体把视网膜信号按通道分流送往 V1，网状核调节中继增益与同步。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: auditory_thalamic_relay_unit
units.description: 内侧膝状体按频率拓扑转发听觉信号，并由皮层下行反馈塑形。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: somatosensory_thalamic_relay_unit
units.description: VPL/VPM 分别中继躯干与面部的触觉/本体感觉，是体感拓扑映射的入口。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: motor_thalamic_relay_unit
units.description: VA/VL 把基底神经节与小脑的输出转给运动皮层，构成两条并行运动通路的共同出口。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cortical_l4_input_unit
units.display: 皮层 L4 输入单元
units.description: 第 4 层接受丘脑输入并立刻被 PV/SST 中间神经元做前馈抑制，把持续输入变成稀疏的时间窗响应。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cortical_l23_association_unit
units.display: 皮层 L2/3 联合单元
units.description: 第 2/3 层在皮层内横向联合，VIP 去抑制让 SST 松开树突，形成可切换的关联态。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cortical_l5_output_unit
units.display: 皮层 L5 输出单元
units.description: 第 5 层是皮层唯一的皮层下出口，粗树突细胞同时投向多个下游并带 KCN 型适应调控持续输出。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cortical_l6_feedback_unit
units.display: 皮层 L6 反馈单元
units.description: 第 6 层双投射细胞把皮层状态回送丘脑，其中一类专门调丘脑中继增益、另一类回皮层内其他层。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cortical_inhibitory_gain_unit
units.description: PV/SST/VIP/chandelier/basket/NPH 六类中间神经元分工——胞体、树突、轴突起始段各有一个刹车位点，合起来是皮层增益控制器。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cortical_highorder_integration_unit
units.description: 第 7 层与长程抑制细胞构成跨模态汇聚区，把来自不同通道的信号在同一群体内做高阶绑定。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cerebellar_cortical_unit
units.description: 苔藓纤维把输入扩到海量颗粒细胞，浦肯野细胞汇聚后经星形/篮状细胞做侧抑制，是『超稀疏展开 + 强收敛』的经典结构。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cerebellar_error_teaching_unit
units.description: 下橄榄的攀爬纤维把运动误差以强全或无信号送到浦肯野细胞，触发 LTD 修正颗粒-浦肯野权重，是监督学习的生理实现。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: hippocampal_trisynaptic_unit
units.description: 内嗅→齿状回→CA3→CA1 三站：齿状回做模式分离、CA3 做自联想、CA1 做输出比较，是情景记忆的最小环。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: hippocampal_ca2_autoassoc_unit
units.display: 海马 CA2 自联想单元
units.description: CA2 缺少典型三突触输入但接收 CA4/CA3 汇入，参与社会记忆与应激响应的特殊亚区。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: hippocampal_output_unit
units.description: 下托整合 CA1 与内嗅的输入并决定往哪个皮层区回送记忆，是记忆读出的路由级。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: entorhinal_spatial_map_unit
units.description: 网格细胞的六边形周期放电与位置/头向细胞共同构成自定位坐标系，是空间记忆的度量基。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: striatal_direct_pathway_unit
units.description: D1 型 MSN 在 dopamine 到达时被易化，抑制苍白球内侧部，从而松开一个动作的刹车。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: striatal_indirect_pathway_unit
units.description: D2 型 MSN 在 dopamine 缺席时活跃，经 STN 兴奋 GPi，给不该做的动作加刹车。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: basal_ganglia_selection_unit
units.display: 基底神经节动作选择单元
units.description: 直接/间接双通路相互竞争，多巴胺同时调节两侧增益——净输出是对候选动作的赢者通吃式选择。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: amygdala_fear_unit
units.description: 外侧杏仁核接收感觉输入，基底外侧核做威胁关联学习，输出条件性恐惧反应。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: septo_hippocampal_theta_unit
units.display: 隔-海马 theta 节律单元
units.description: 隔核与斜角带胆碱能细胞给海马提供 theta 节律驱动，是记忆编码与检索的时间基准。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: hypothalamic_arousal_unit
units.description: 食欲素、组胺、去甲肾上腺素三路共同维持清醒稳定：食欲素缺失导致状态切换不稳（发作性睡病）。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: spinal_reflex_arc_unit
units.description: 感觉传入→中间神经元→运动神经元的两站式最短回路，可在无脑参与下完成保护性动作。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: spinal_cpg_unit
units.display: 脊髓中枢模式发生器单元
units.description: 半中心 Ihp 与连合 Icc 中间神经元组成互抑制振荡器，产生交替节律（行走/游动/呼吸共用同一原理）。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: gamma_spindle_loop_unit
units.description: γ 运动神经元设定肌梭灵敏度，α 运动神经元输出力，Ia 反馈构成伺服回路实时校准收缩。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: red_nucleus_coordination_unit
units.description: 红核把小脑输出的时序信息转为对 α 运动神经元的直接驱动，协调多关节动作的时序与幅度。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: dopaminergic_value_unit
units.description: 中脑多巴胺群体（A9/A11/VMC/VTA/SNc）把奖赏预测误差广播到纹状体与皮层，是全脑的学习率旋钮。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: serotonergic_mood_unit
units.description: 背侧/腹侧/中缝三组 5-HT 群体分别调节情绪、奖赏与海马节律，是全局时间尺度上的『心情』底色。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cholinergic_arousal_unit
units.description: 基底前脑与斜角带胆碱能细胞调节皮层兴奋性与丘脑同步，是注意与觉醒的共同杠杆。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: circadian_clock_unit
units.description: 松果体在暗期分泌褪黑素，视网膜辐照度信号是它的授时输入，构成约 24 小时的内源振荡。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: astrocyte_tripartite_unit
units.description: 星形胶质细胞包绕突触、感知活动并以钙波回送慢调节信号，是神经元之外的一条独立慢通道。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: antennal_lobe_glomerular_unit
units.description: 感受神经元投射到球状体，局部中间神经元做跨球归一化，投射神经元把气味通道送进蘑菇体和高位侧角。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: mushroom_body_sparse_code_unit
units.description: 投射神经元在约两千个 Kenyon 细胞上随机展开，单个 APL 神经元全局回抑制把活动压到约 5%，得到高维稀疏气味码。
units.biological_reference: Laurent 2002; Turner et al 2008; Papadopoulou et al 2011

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: mushroom_body_associative_memory_unit
units.description: 多巴胺能神经元把奖赏/惩罚送到 Kenyon 细胞输出突触上做门控，只有气味与效价同时出现时权重才变，读出由 MBON 完成。
units.biological_reference: Heisenberg 2003; Aso et al 2014; Cognigni et al 2018

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: central_complex_heading_unit
units.description: 脑桥与椭球体构成环形吸引子，环神经元整形出单个活动峰，峰的位置就是当前朝向，给出不依赖视觉瞬时输入的方位记忆。
units.biological_reference: Seelig & Jayaraman 2015; Green et al 2017; Turner-Evans et al 2017

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: central_complex_steering_unit
units.description: 扇形体的分层目标图把当前朝向与期望朝向的差转成转向量，结节提供自身速度门控，下行神经元把指令送进腹神经索。
units.biological_reference: Strausfeld 1999; Green et al 2017; Rayshubskiy et al 2020

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: insect_clock_pacemaker_unit
units.description: 小腹侧侧神经元以 PDF 肽与电耦合把昼夜相位分发给侧神经元网络，松果体作为跨物种的褪黑素效应端被一并纳入。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: birdsong_hvc_timing_unit
units.description: HVC 用链式激活把静态前运动指令展开成毫秒级时序，每个神经元在音节的一个极短时间窗内爆发，为下游提供节拍。
units.biological_reference: Hahnloser et al 2002; Long & Fee 2008; Picardo et al 2016

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: birdsong_ra_motor_unit
units.description: RA 把来自 HVC 的时序窗转成对鸣管运动神经元与呼吸运动神经元的爆发式驱动，音节与呼吸必须严格配准。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: birdsong_basal_ganglia_learning_unit
units.description: 前脑通路 Area X 到 DLM 到 LMAN 的基底神经节环路，用听觉误差与多巴胺能价值信号把探索性变异筛选成稳定音节。
units.biological_reference: Bottjer et al 1984; Mooney 2009; Andalman & Fee 2009

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: startle_escape_command_unit
units.description: 侧线或听觉的突然输入经电化学混合突触在亚毫秒内点燃 Mauthner 细胞，单个指令神经元全部或无地召集对侧网状脊髓池，形成 C 型逃逸。
units.biological_reference: Zottoli 1977; Eaton et al 2001; Korn & Faber 2005

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: passive_electroreception_unit
units.description: 壶腹型感受器探测猎物肌肉与鳃产生的低频弱电场，电感受侧线叶把三叉神经输入变成方向性猎物向量。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: electrosensory_electrolocation_unit
units.description: 结节型感受器读取自身电器官放电被物体扭曲后的振幅与相位，传出副本先把自身电场分量减掉，剩下的才是外部目标。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: electric_organ_discharge_unit
units.description: 起搏核自主节律发放，经中继核与脊髓运动神经元驱动电器官，同时把传出副本并行送给电感受通路用于抵消。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cephalopod_vertical_lobe_learning_unit
units.display: 头足类垂直叶学习单元
units.description: 小细胞把视觉/触觉/化学触觉汇聚进垂直叶，无长突细胞连续数次发放后对大型细胞输出突触产生持续增强，学习规则是反复激活而非成对 STDP。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cephalopod_chromatophore_control_unit
units.description: 额上叶高层指令经色素细胞运动神经元控制放射肌，把色素囊撑开或收拢，在不到一秒内铺出整片皮肤图案。

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier

units.name: cephalopod_arm_motor_unit
units.description: 腕的神经索自带运动神经元与感觉传入，脑只下达粗略高层指令，精细运动与本体感觉闭环都在腕内本地完成。
units.biological_reference: Young 1965; Sumbre et al 2001; Zullo et al 2009

provenance.basis: comparative-neuroscience literature, not a trained classifier
